study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective observational study
cohort: 1009 small-for-gestational-age neonates born to women with a single prior cesarean delivery
finding: Small-for-gestational-age infants born to women who attempt a trial of labor after cesarean have similar neonatal outcomes to those who deliver by planned repeat cesarean.
mod_finding: For small-for-gestational-age neonates, trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) had similar neonatal outcomes compared to planned repeat cesarean.
